issue.title: Task dependency links: one Depends-On line, a vault-wide Ctrl+Shift+P picker, and live chips
issue.description: A task's prerequisites live as plain task dependency links on one managed `⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:**` first-child line. That line is the source of truth, and the `[dependsOn::]` / `[id::]` fields are derived from it. Ctrl+Shift+P adds and removes prerequisites by fuzzy-searching every open task in the vault. bob-ledger-tools draws each link as a live status chip. The vault no longer uses transcluded dependency bullets. The glossary, docs, and decision records describe the new contract.
